description: Where the request text sits in a delegated child's first request (agent#11): the child's request text is its objective, which delegation.ts hands the child as context.objective and the adapter sends as the first text part of the child's first message, before the child's prompt (its profile's instructions and the JSON of its objective and context) and the state. So the rule (budget.json#/$defs/recallQuery) finds the objective, not the end of the supplied context. Written by hand from the schema on the OpenAI-compatible wire, the body abbreviated; memory/recall.test.ts runs a child of the review profile and holds its first request to the item. This harness's.
